meta.title: Auction closes without award when End Price is reached with no acceptance
gaps: Ensure the event is specifically a live Dutch auction and drive each round until the End Price is reached.
Ensure no vendor accepts in every Dutch auction round before the End Price is reached.
Directly assert that the auction closed specifically because the End Price was reached rather than another closing condition.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Ensure the event is specifically a live Dutch auction and drive each round until the End Price is reached.; Ensure no vendor accepts in every Dutch auction round before the End Price is reached.; Directly assert that the auction closed specifically because the End Price was reached rather than another closing condition.

steps.note: Open an existing live event selected by the runner as the closest available auction state.
Wait for the auction's bidding window to close without forcing an award.
Verify the event is shown as closed in the events list.
Verify the closed event shows no accepted vendor bid, supporting that no vendor was awarded.
